scope_and_limitations: The movie shows real iOS Simulator application capture from b4a584f, composed from three actual sessions with pauses shortened by editing. It is not a physical iPhone recording or a claim of one uninterrupted session.

This review accepts UI appearance, readable captions and context at the reviewed chapter samples. Audio capture, synchronization, levels and complete-stream decoding are verified separately by the root agent; this reviewer does not claim listening approval.
Voice shows recording preparation only, explicitly BETA MONO with manual-result review; no actual human voice recognition or Voice-to-MIDI conversion result is demonstrated.
Assistant shows local Commands with visible on-device-model unavailability; there is no real FoundationModels generation claim.
The saved performance shown is 53.1 seconds and 10 events. The following export/share chapters demonstrate ordinary project WAV mixdown, not export of that live take.
No external MIDI controller, physical audio-route, device-latency, thermal or App Store release claim is established.
The later Settings theme fix and first-run guide are not demonstrated by this older b4a capture. Their accepted native screenshots and focused tests are separate evidence.
Visual acceptance does not turn the original capture job into a successful test run; its postroll failure remains preserved in the separate source/render provenance.
